sched_o_daf_text_cur: [FORM 990, PART VI, LINE 4:] THE FOUNDATION IS A US PUBLIC CHARITY THAT IS, ONLY WITH RESPECT TO ITS DONOR-ADVISED FUNDS, A SPONSORING ORGANIZATION. THROUGH THE USE OF AN ONLINE CHARITABLE GIVING PLATFORM, CORPORATE DONORS CAN MAKE DONATIONS INTO SUCH DONOR-ADVISED FUNDS AND PROVIDE ONGOING ADVICE REGARDING RELATED GRANTS TO ELIGIBLE CHARITIES. INDIVIDUAL DONORS MAY USE THE PLATFORM TO MAKE MICRO-DONATIONS AND RECOMMEND GRANTS TO ELIGIBLE CHARITIES AT OR NEAR THE TIME OF DONATION, WITHOUT ONGOING ADVISORY PRIVILEGES WITH RESPECT TO THEIR DONATIONS. THE FOUNDATION MAY, IN ITS DISCRETION, MAKE GRANTS TO RECOMMENDED CHARITIES OR TO OTHER CHARITIES FOLLOWING ITS VERIFICATION AND APPROVAL PROCESS.

sched_o_daf_text_cur: [FORM 990 - FINAL RETURN] THE AYCO CHARITABLE FOUNDATION MERGED WITH A RELATED ORGANIZATION, GS DONOR ADVISED PHILANTHROPY FUND, EFFECTIVE JULY 1, 2025. THE FOUNDATION IS FILING A FINAL RETURN FOR THE YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2025, WHICH IS ITS FINAL DAY OF OPERATION. || [PART IV, LINE 12A-12B & PART XII, LINE 2B] ACF MERGED WITH GS DAF ON JULY 1, 2025. AS THE TWO ORGANIZATIONS WERE UNDER COMMON CONTROL, IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE REQUIREMENTS FOR BUSINESS COMBINATIONS OF ENTITIES UNDER COMMON CONTROL, GS DAF ACCOUNTED FOR THE MERGER WITH ACF AS A CHANGE IN REPORTING ENTITY AND RECORDED THE ASSETS AND LIABILITIES OF ACF AT THEIR HISTORICAL CARRYING VALUES AS OF THE DATE OF THE MERGER. PRIOR PERIOD AMOUNTS ARE PRESENTED AS IF THE MERGER HAD OCCURRED AT THE BEGINNING OF 2024. THEREFORE, THE GS DAF FINANCIAL STATEMENTS INCLUDE THE COMBINED FINANCIAL POSITION OF GS DAF AND ACF FOR 2025.
